name: VC Dimension of Private-Coordinate Cubes
proof: Projection onto the original coordinates is the full $n$-cube, so those coordinates are shattered. The class has $2^n$ distinct concepts, and shattering $d$ coordinates requires at least $2^d$ concepts. Hence VC is exactly $n$.
references: Direct counting and shattering proof; \cite{KSZ2019}, Proposition 26, records the underlying teaching/VC separation and credits Goldman--Kearns.
